description: This file contains implementation of classes and methods for handling BCCH-DL-SCH messages in 5G NR RRC protocol, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Class representing the BCCH-DL-SCH message type with options for different message choices.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_type_c::c1_c_
classes.description: Nested class handling specific message types within bcch_dl_sch_msg_type_c, such as sys_info and sib_type1.

classes.name: bcch_dl_sch_msg_s
classes.description: Class representing the entire BCCH-DL-SCH message as a sequence, with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON conversion.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1 and returns reference to c1 object.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON format.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit stream.

methods.name: set_sys_info
methods.description: Sets the message to sys_info type and returns reference.

methods.name: set_sib_type1
methods.description: Sets the message to sib_type1 type and returns reference.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the nested object to JSON.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the nested object into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the nested object from bit stream.
